primary_goal: attribute H4/H5 discrepancy without fitting that ratio alone
comparison_policy: Report H1..H16 with independent-channel power and F0 from summed channel autocorrelation.
Keep original mono-fold harmonic metric only for historical comparison.
Use model stages as interventions, not hardware-isolated recordings.
Only whole-patch parameter interventions are eligible for cross-preset checking.
Never promote a raw component ablation, forced polarity/reset or retuned SysEx based on a single partial.
Check first/second halves of the reference and same candidate window before judging a stationary mismatch.
Keep all stage scores; check promising whole-patch interventions on other existing references; no engine defaults changed.
